title_en: Energy levels of the hydrogen atom — concept check
subject: physics
description_en: Equation or lab concept with explained answer.

questions.q: If hydrogen's ground-state energy is −13.6 eV, what is E₂ in the Bohr model?
questions.q_bn: হাইড্রোজেনের ভূমিস্তর −১৩.৬ eV হলে বোর মডেলে E₂ কত?
questions.explanation: Eₙ=−13.6/n² eV, giving −13.6/4=−3.4 eV for n=2.
